blocks.body: {"level":"B2","intro":"Linking Words for Reason, Result and Contrast: Linking Words for Reason, Result and Contrast focuses on because of, due to, therefore, as a result, although, despite, and however.","rules":[{"label":"Reason","text":"Use because of or due to before nouns and noun phrases.","example":"Because of the traffic, we arrived late."},{"label":"Result","text":"Use so, therefore, or as a result to show consequence.","example":"It was late, so we took a taxi."},{"label":"Contrast","text":"Use although, despite, however, or nevertheless for contrast.","example":"Although it was cold, we went out."}]}

blocks.body: {"level":"C1","intro":"Advanced Linking Devices: compact anchors for precise logical relations in C1 writing and speech.","rules":[{"label":"Concession","text":"Use although, even though, despite, and nevertheless to contrast an expected result.","example":"Although the evidence was limited, the study was influential."},{"label":"Result","text":"Use therefore, consequently, and as a result for formal cause-result flow.","example":"The data were incomplete; consequently, the conclusion was revised."},{"label":"Condition and addition","text":"Use provided that, insofar as, furthermore, and moreover to build controlled argument structure.","example":"The plan is feasible provided that funding is secured."}]}

page.subtitle_text: C2 ways to balance contrast, concession, and qualification.

blocks.body: {"level":"C2","intro":"Concessive and contrastive structures: compact anchors for although, while, whereas, even though, and related C2 contrast patterns.","rules":[{"label":"Concession","text":"Use although, even though, despite, and in spite of to concede one point while maintaining another.","example":"Although the evidence was limited, the conclusion was convincing."},{"label":"Contrast","text":"Use while and whereas to compare two different facts or positions.","example":"While some experts are optimistic, others remain cautious."},{"label":"Balanced qualification","text":"Place contrast clauses carefully so the main claim remains clear.","example":"The policy is ambitious, even if its implementation remains uncertain."}]}
